uniqueness-internal.limit: Candidate aggregate for each refund's customer. Confirm grouping semantics in OS2.

uniqueness-external.formula: NOT EXISTS(Enrolment.student(Student) AND Enrolment.course(Course) AND other.student(Student) AND other.course(Course) AND Enrolment != other)
uniqueness-external.limit: Candidate paired witnesses for the enrolment model's composite uniqueness.

mandatory.limit: Candidate presence test at the participating concept.

guarded.limit: Scoped refund policy; modality is carried separately.

ring.limit: Self-loop probe only. The census acyclic rule needs transitive reachability, so syntax acceptance does not cover it.

subtype-partition.formula: (BookItem OR PeriodicalItem) AND NOT (BookItem AND PeriodicalItem)
subtype-partition.limit: Probes union and disjointness with the census subtype names.

value.limit: The allowed values in the library example.

textual.limit: Manual reading of the library text. There is no generic translation for unconstrained text.

anchored.limit: Deliberate absent-evidence probe. A source span has no binding in the native ontology projection.
